why: Search summaries say the cirque holds snow into July and the route is tagged a snow route, but August reports vary, so the season stays unsettled.
The route page describes snowy ridge pitches from an April, winter-condition ascent and says other seasons allow rock shoes, so the usual season is unclear.
The page says the couloir is a steep hike without snow and a snow climb with it, and never states when snow is normally present.
Mountain Project tags it Snow with a spring/winter snow approach but describes summer approach as boulder fields; normal season unclear.
